_meta.name: DSA FX-share dataset (adjudicated + audited)
_meta.description: Foreign-currency share of public debt, latest available eligible observation per country (actual or staff estimate, labeled), extracted from the most recent published IMF DSA for each country (LIC-DSF and MAC SRDSF staff reports), human-adjudicated, and independently audited against every cited source page.
_meta.source_package: TEA-878 adjudicated final (row-identical to TEA-879 dataset-final.csv) plus TEA-880 QA corrections of 2026-07-23 (BWA, GAB, KWT, LBN, SVK, KIR)

qa_audit.coverage: all 167 cited source pages independently re-read

policy.year: latest available eligible observation (actual or staff estimate), status labeled per country
policy.figure_precision: chart-derived values are estimates; UI displays them as approximate integers

derivation.note: The share is stated directly on the cited page.

audit.note: Citation (page and file hash) corrected to the adjudicated final package; value re-verified against the corrected page.
